answer.explanation: Average contribution was below 30%, so increased contribution by extra 30% (capped by wallet) to 62.52. Praised Resident2 for high cooperation.

message.reasoning:
We need to follow constitution. Wallet 62.52, baseline 80% = 0.8*62.52=50.016. Average contribution? compute total contributions so far: round1 total_pool 163 includes contributions sum? contributions given: sum =1+80+1+1+80+0=163 correct. Average per agent =163/6≈27.17 which is below 30% of endowment (30). So condition triggers: increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. Extra 30% of wallet =0.3*62.52=18.756. Baseline 80% 50.016 + extra =68.772. Can't exceed wallet 62.52, so we can only contribute up to wallet. Constitution says increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet to push group back up. But if exceeds wallet, we contribute full wallet. So contribute full wallet 62.52.

Also check punish free riders: need any agent contributed <10% endowment (10) for two consecutive rounds. Look at contributions: Resident1: round1 1 (<10), round2 0 (<10) => two consecutive low. So punish Resident1 with amount 10 (severity). Cost to us 0.3*10=3, we have enough wallet? Wallet after contribution will be reduced by contribution then we can punish? Order: pool settlement then punish. After contribution, wallet becomes 0? Actually we contributed full wallet, so wallet becomes 0. Then cannot afford punishment cost 3, so punishment will be skipped. Maybe better to conserve resources? Our wallet below 30%? 30% of initial =30. Wallet now 62.52 >30, so no conserve rule.

We could contribute 50.016 baseline and keep some for punish. But constitution says increase contribution when avg<30. Should we still increase? Yes condition triggers, so we must increase. Could we increase baseline + extra but limited by wallet, so full wallet is okay.

We cannot punish due to no funds; that's fine.

Communication: it's round 2, need broadcast every 5 rounds starting round1, so next broadcast at round6. Could send private praise to high cooperators (>=60%). Who contributed >=60% of wallet? Resident2 contributed 48.6, that's 48.6% of initial endowment? But rule: "identify agents who contributed at least 60% of their wallet". Their wallet at start of round2 was? After round1 they got share 40.75 so wallet = initial 100 -80 +40.75 =60.75? Actually Resident2 contributed 80, then got share 40.75, so wallet =100-80+40.75=60.75. They contributed 48.6 which is 80% of wallet (48.6/60.75≈80%). That's >=60%. So praise Resident2.

We already have private message from Resident2, but we can send private_message to Resident2 praising.

Thus actions: contribute full wallet 62.52 and private_message to Resident2.
